answer: Time-locked physical entropy: each agent must periodically submit a reading from a quartz oscillator whose micro-drift is seeded by local temperature and vibration, hashed against a sparrow-sized tamper beacon in a sealed vault. No two physical locations produce the same drift sequence, so one operator cannot fabricate many distinct histories. Attackers must rent, transport, and maintain genuinely separate hardware per identity; costs scale linearly with clone count, defeating cheap duplication.
